spans.text: Simulates a single worker pulling from a queue that refuses new work once it holds wip_limit items, and returns throughput and average wait so that runs with and without a limit can be compared.

items.text: Each tick, an item arrives with probability
and joins the queue only if it is below the limit.
the oldest item finishes and its wait (current tick minus arrival tick) is recorded.
After all ticks it returns completed items per tick and the mean recorded wait.

spans.text: Arrivals over the limit are simply not appended, so the model never counts the work waiting upstream; the author notes that in a real team that hidden queue still exists.
